mock.title: Account
mock.signedIn: Signed in as {{name}} ({{role}}) with this machine’s sign-in picker: there is no password or passkey to manage. Switch user from the account menu.
mock.signedIn_nobody: Signed in with this machine’s sign-in picker: there is no password or passkey to manage. Switch user from the account menu.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Sign in with your device's fingerprint, face or PIN instead of a password.

password.title: Password
password.changed: Password changed; other sessions signed out

social.title: Google and Apple
social.description: Sign in with a Google or Apple account you link here, on this website and in the $t(common:product) app. Linking never shares your password with them.
social.loadFailed: Could not load your linked accounts.

result.linked: Account linked. You can sign in with it now.
result.expired: Linking took too long and expired. Try again.
result.provider-unavailable: Linking isn’t available on this server right now.
result.nonce-invalid: This link attempt expired, was used already, or was started in another browser or session. Try again.
result.not-authorized: Sign in again, then link the account.
result.already-linked-other: That account is already linked to another person here.
result.method-off: That way of signing in is turned off here.
result.too-many: Too many tries. Try again in a minute.
result.failed: Could not link the account. Try again.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Signs this account out on every device, this one included.

leave.title: Leave workspace
leave.description: Ends your membership: you are signed out on every device and can't sign in again unless an admin brings you back. What you made stays with the workspace, where admins can hand it to someone else.
leave.confirmBody: You will be signed out everywhere, including the $t(common:product) app on your phone, which erases its copy. Your chats, pages and other work stay with the workspace. Only an admin can let you back in.
